SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'preopen' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preopen, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'preaward' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preaward, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'exception' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exception FROM tb_purchase_ledger
AND ( org_id = #{scopeId} OR org_id IN ( SELECT t.thrid_dept_id FROM sys_dept t WHERE FIND_IN_SET( (SELECT dept_id FROM sys_dept WHERE thrid_dept_id = #{scopeId}), t.ancestors) ) )

SELECT l.method AS method, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_purchase_ledger l INNER JOIN tb_bidding_result br ON br.id = ( SELECT br2.id FROM tb_bidding_result br2 WHERE br2.notice_id = l.notice_id AND br2.bid_result = 1 AND br2.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY br2.update_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE l.grain = 'TASK' AND l.status = 'completed' AND l.method IN (1, 2, 3, 4) AND br.notifi_time IS NOT NULL
AND ( l.org_id = #{orgId} OR l.org_id IN ( SELECT t.thrid_dept_id FROM sys_dept t WHERE FIND_IN_SET( (SELECT dept_id FROM sys_dept WHERE thrid_dept_id = #{orgId}), t.ancestors) ) )
AND YEAR(br.notifi_time) = #{year}
GROUP BY l.method

SELECT vendor_name AS vendorName, COALESCE(SUM(contract_amount), 0) AS contractAmount FROM tb_vendor_report
vendor_name IS NOT NULL AND vendor_name != ''
AND ( party_a_org_id = #{scopeId} OR party_a_org_id IN ( SELECT t.thrid_dept_id FROM sys_dept t WHERE FIND_IN_SET( (SELECT dept_id FROM sys_dept WHERE thrid_dept_id = #{scopeId}), t.ancestors) ) )
GROUP BY vendor_name ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(contract_amount), 0) DESC LIMIT 5
